constraints: This stage does not change clinical_decision, clinical_level, formal_pick_allowed, or the existing selection_role.
Possible pathogen is a reporting role, not a proven causal or primary pathogen claim.
Reads remain per-test evidence and are never summed across DNA, RNA, or technical repeats.
Repeated sequencing is one analytical reproducibility axis and is not independent clinical confirmation.
Exact event-aligned Level 3 culture or positive targeted respiratory detection may support a possible-pathogen role while retaining quantity and interpretation cautions.
Repeated sterile-site observations trigger review only; distinct observation IDs do not prove independently collected blood sets.

Respiratory Candida, herpes/reactivation viruses, PJP, molds, anaerobes, other respiratory viruses, and unmapped organisms keep their family-specific safeguards and cannot use the generic possible-pathogen routes.
Zero-read source rows are not positive evidence and cannot create a possible pathogen.
Phenotype, treatment response, WBC, CRP, and outcome do not independently create a possible pathogen in this policy.
Missing evidence is not treated as negative and never removes or demotes a candidate.
The policy is answer blind; benchmark answers are used only by a separate post-hoc evaluator.
